stage: V9A ensemble search plan — PLAN-ONLY package (V9-20.1)
immutability: plan frozen before any result; a failed execute is immutable and never tuned/rerun; no result may alter this plan
lifecycle: plan-only -> independent read-only review -> exactly one deterministic execute (all four searches + all validation seeds) -> exactly one strict read-only replay -> gate decision
round1_scope: Round 1 creates and freezes this plan ONLY. No search, no probe, no canary, no validation-seed run is executed in Round 1. Execution is a later round after independent plan review.

field.field_tables: GF2mField from nonbinary_field (accepted field tables, import-only reuse)
field.message_model: full length-1024 probability-domain vectors; scalar reliability surrogate forbidden
field.check_update: coefficient-correct WHT convolution (own fwht_batched), validated against the independent V8 direct oracle at q=4/8/32 and bounded q=1024 within the frozen tolerance 1e-9

sizing.formula: H_q(p) = (h2(p) + p*log2(q-1)) / log2(q);  m(f,p,n) = ceil(f * H_q(p) * n);  R = 1 - m/n

informative_expected.note: informative values are 7-decimal rounded; tests assert formula-exactness at 1e-12 and informative agreement at 1e-7; the module computes the formula and never hard-codes these constants

validation.rule: the winning candidate of each search is re-evaluated on the 3 validation seeds with the same probe ranges; the conservative threshold is the MINIMUM over the 3 seeds of the per-seed threshold proxy

candidates.applied_to: all four searches, in the frozen canonical order C1..C8 (the tie-break order)

rho_rule.construction: harmonic-exact concentrated two-point check-degree distribution from the target rate: target = (1 - R) * sum_i lambda_i/i with R = 1 - m/n; dc = 1/target; on the adjacent degrees dc_lo = floor(dc), dc_hi = dc_lo + 1 set w_lo = (target - 1/dc_hi) / (1/dc_lo - 1/dc_hi), w_hi = 1 - w_lo; an integer dc degenerates to the regular single check degree
rho_rule.rate_condition: sum_j rho_j/j == target exactly; reconstructed rate |1 - (sum rho_j/j)/(sum lambda_i/i) - R| <= 1e-12
rho_rule.implementation: own v9 implementation (nonbinary_v9_common.concentrated_check_distribution), validated against the V8-60 formula within 1e-12 in tests; V8 is a test-only reference

budgets.convergence_rule: entropy < entropy_tol for streak consecutive iterations

threshold_search.method: deterministic binary search (threshold_binary_search), same frozen seed per probe
threshold_search.threshold_proxy: largest p (to p_tol) for which the MC-DE run converges

selection_rule.per_search: winner = candidate with the maximum threshold proxy evaluated on the optimization seed
selection_rule.ties: broken by canonical candidate order C1..C8

robust_f115.failure: freeze evidence and STOP before any finite codebook; no V9B plan

target_f108.failure: robust-only continuation with efficiency_target_not_met for that stratum; no target claim

gates.p20_target_capacity_note: .215 remains below the approximate p=.20 f=1.08 capacity threshold ~.21827, preserving a feasible target

gate_reconstruction.formula: for each search: gate_outcome = PASS iff conservative_threshold >= gate_conservative; conservative_threshold = min over validation seeds of threshold_binary_search(winner, seed).threshold_proxy
gate_reconstruction.example: S1: conservative = min(proxy(2026090111), proxy(2026090112), proxy(2026090113)) over the S1 winner; robust gate PASS iff conservative >= 0.22

resource_policy.rss_watcher: ctypes-only process-tree RSS watcher (toolhelp32 snapshot, sum WorkingSetSize of parent + children; stdlib ctypes only; NO psutil, NO installation)

rank_policy.rule: sparse GF(1024) Gaussian elimination using GF2mField tables (imported from nonbinary_field only); require rank(H)=m for every finite matrix before any plan
rank_policy.reconstruction: bounded deterministic reconstruction <= 5 attempts (relabel with the next frozen label seed) then BLOCKER
rank_policy.scope_note: policy frozen in this plan; the rank utility and finite-codebook enforcement are V9B-round work (Round 1 freezes the policy and unit-tests the utility contract on small cases)

leakage_policy.hard_caps: exact mechanical hard caps; no other reconciliation payload
leakage_policy.public_control: Toeplitz verification seed bits (n*10 + 63) documented separately (accepted verifier shared.verification_result)
leakage_policy.forbidden: puncturing, shortening, interactive/adaptive stages, information-bearing index/control payload; blind rate adaptation deferred to a future V10 change
leakage_policy.fixed_rate_per_stratum: V9C uses one fixed rate per stratum: f=1.08 only where its target gate passed, else f=1.15 with efficiency_target_not_met

stop_rules: any robust conservative gate failure (S1 < 0.22 or S3 < 0.32) => freeze immutable evidence and STOP before codebooks
target conservative gate failure (S2 < 0.215 or S4 < 0.32) => robust-only downstream with efficiency_target_not_met
a failed execute is immutable: no tuning, no rerun, no altered plan
no qualification/confirmation/real-data/N4/promotion/formal-comparison work is authorized by this plan
v8_boundary: V8's q=4 reproduction validates the method and audit machinery only; it is not a GF(1024) threshold or FER result. All GF(1024) thresholds in this plan come from the frozen V9A package, never from V8 numbers.
